question: HA#559 OQ-1: when one ladder aspect improves in one way and regresses in another, which glyph does the row get?

options.label: ⬇ with both halves ⭐ (Recommended)
options.consequence: The conservative reading: the row shows ⬇ and its reason must name the gain and the loss. No new glyph; recorded as an HR row in the improves-ladder canon.

options.label: A fourth mixed glyph
options.consequence: A new glyph (e.g. ↕) means 'both ways'; the reason names both halves. Every ladder reader and renderer learns the new glyph.
